# 1 load data 
```{r load data, include=FALSE}

library(here)
source(here("config.R"))   # provides data_dir

# tidyverse already loads ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, tibble, readr, purrr, stringr, forcats, lubridate
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggforce)
library(esc)
library(effsize)
library(nlme)
library(metafor)
library(corrplot)
library(car)
library(multcomp)  # post hoc tests (note: loads MASS, which masks dplyr::select)
library(lme4)

# plyr and reshape2 removed: plyr clashes with dplyr, reshape2 is superseded by tidyr

# "UTF-8-BOM" stops the "ï..Dataset_ID" column name from appearing
df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "df_2.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dataset_ID, Exp_ID, Site, Location, Country), as.factor))

```

# 2 data check
## numbers
```{r data check}

#duration - create age class
df$Dur_Age_Class <- cut(df$Duration, seq(0, 30, 5), right = FALSE, labels = 1:6)
summary(df$Dur_Age_Class)
#put age class 4, 5 and 6 together (>15 years) cfr original supp fig 5
df$Dur_Age_Class <- fct_collapse(df$Dur_Age_Class, "4" = c("4", "5", "6"))
df$Dur_Age_Class <- droplevels(df$Dur_Age_Class)
summary(df$Dur_Age_Class)


#duration - remove orphans in subset  (for within-experiment models)
Nr_ER_years <- df %>% group_by(Exp_ID) %>% summarize(NrER_years = n_distinct(Year))
Exp_ID_orphans    <- as.character(Nr_ER_years$Exp_ID[Nr_ER_years$NrER_years == 1]) #orphans (1 year)
Exp_ID_no_orphans <- as.character(Nr_ER_years$Exp_ID[Nr_ER_years$NrER_years > 1])  #no orphans (>1 year)

df_orphans    <- df %>% filter(Exp_ID %in% Exp_ID_orphans)     #115 datasets covering 35 experiments
df_no_orphans <- df %>% filter(!Exp_ID %in% Exp_ID_orphans)    #21 datasets/experiments

```

# 3 metaregression 
## ACROSS experiments: ~Duration

```{r function R2}
r2_rma.mv <- function(model, null.model) { 
  r2.sigma  <- (sum(null.model$sigma2) - sum(model$sigma2)) / sum(null.model$sigma2)
  r2.loglik <- 1 - (logLik(model) / logLik(null.model))
  cbind(r2.sigma, r2.loglik)
}

#colorblind friendly palette
cbPalette <- c("#999999", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")
# 1 grijs 2 oranje 3 blauw 4 groen 5 geel 6 blauw 7 feloranje, 8 roze

# Cohen reference lines, reused in every figure
smd_hlines <- list(
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.8,  linetype="dashed", color=cbPalette[7], linewidth=0.6),
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.5,  linetype="dashed", color=cbPalette[2], linewidth=0.6),
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.2,  linetype="dashed", color=cbPalette[5], linewidth=0.6),
  geom_hline(yintercept=0,    linetype="dashed", color="black",      linewidth=2),
  geom_hline(yintercept=-0.2, linetype="dashed", color=cbPalette[1], linewidth=0.6),
  geom_hline(yintercept=-0.5, linetype="dashed", color=cbPalette[3], linewidth=0.6),
  geom_hline(yintercept=-0.8, linetype="dashed", color=cbPalette[6], linewidth=0.6)
)
smd_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.margin = unit(c(1.2,1.2,1.2,1.2), "cm"), axis.text = element_text(size = rel(1.1)))
```

### 1) No age classes
#### model output
```{r single models no age class}

#Significant effect of duration as continuous driver?
RMADuration<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Duration)
summary(RMADuration)

RMADuration_Machine_Type<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Duration+Machine_Type)
summary(RMADuration_Machine_Type)
```

#### pseudoR² 
```{r Pseudo R2 no age class}
#Duration
subset<-df %>% filter(!is.na(Duration))
Observation_ID_subset<-1:nrow(subset)
RMAnull<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=subset, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID_subset , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~ 1, method="ML") 
RMADuration_ml<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=subset, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID_subset , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~ Duration, method="ML")
r2_Duration<-r2_rma.mv(RMADuration_ml, RMAnull) 
r2_Duration #r2.loglik = used in manuscript

#Duration + Machine_Type
RMADuration_Machine_Type_ml<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=subset, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID_subset , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~ Machine_Type+ Duration, method="ML")
r2_Duration_Machine_Type<-r2_rma.mv(RMADuration_Machine_Type_ml, RMAnull) 
r2_Duration_Machine_Type #r2.loglik = used in manuscript
```

#### model validation
```{r model validation no age class}
Err<-resid(RMADuration) 
Fit<-fitted(RMADuration) 
plot(x=Fit, y=Err, xlab="fitted values", ylab="residuals", main="RMADuration - Residuals vs fitted SMD")
hist(Fit, main="Histogram fitted values SMD")
qqnorm(Err, ylab="residuals", xlab="scores") 
plot(x=df$Duration, y=Err, xlab="Duration", ylab="Residuals")
```

#### effect plot
##### regplot

```{r regplot no age class}
regplot(RMADuration, mod="Duration", xlab="Duration", ylab="Hedges SMD ER")
```

##### manuscript
```{r fig Duration, echo=FALSE}
model<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df,
              random = list(~ 1 | Exp_ID/Observation_ID, ~ Year | Exp_ID),
              struct="CAR", mods= ~ Duration)

intercept<-coef(model)[[1]]
slope<-coef(model)[[2]]
Qm<-model$QM
p_value<-model$pval[2]
N<-model$k

Durationmin<-min(df$Duration, na.rm=TRUE)
Durationmax<-max(df$Duration, na.rm=TRUE)

pred_df <- as.data.frame(predict(model, newmods=seq(Durationmin, Durationmax, length.out=20), addx=TRUE)) %>%
  rename(newmods = X.Duration)

eqn <- sprintf(
  "italic(y) == %.3g + %.3g * italic(x) * ',' ~~ italic(Qm) ~ '=' ~ %.2g * ',' ~~ italic(p) ~ '=' ~ %.1g * ',' ~~ italic(N) ~ '=' ~ %.0f",
  intercept, slope, Qm, p_value, N)

# pdf("1a_Fig_Across_Exp_NoAgeClass.pdf", width=10, height=10)
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data=df, aes(x=Duration, y=Hedges_SMD), size=1/sqrt(df$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE), shape=21, fill="#D3D3D3") +
  geom_line(data=pred_df, aes(x=newmods, y=pred), color=cbPalette[6], linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data=pred_df, aes(x=newmods, ymin=ci.lb, ymax=ci.ub), linetype=2, alpha=0.1, color=cbPalette[6]) +
  ylab("Hedges SMD") + xlab("Duration") +
  smd_hlines + smd_theme +
  annotate("text", x=Durationmin, y=-1, label=eqn, parse=TRUE, hjust=0, size=5, color=cbPalette[6])
# dev.off()
```

```{r fig Duration Machine_Type, echo=FALSE}
model<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df,
              random = list(~ 1 | Exp_ID/Observation_ID, ~ Year | Exp_ID),
              struct="CAR", mods= ~ Duration + Machine_Type)

intercept<-coef(model)[[1]]
slope<-coef(model)[[2]]
Qm<-model$QM
p_value<-model$pval[2]
N<-model$k

# newmods must be numeric dummy columns, one per non-reference Machine_Type level.
# Here all dummies = 0, i.e. predictions for the REFERENCE level of Machine_Type
# (check with levels(factor(df$Machine_Type)); the old cbind(..., factor("IR")) did not do what it looked like).
n_mt_dummies <- length(coef(model)) - 2
dur_seq <- seq(Durationmin, Durationmax, length.out=20)
pred_df <- as.data.frame(predict(model, newmods=cbind(dur_seq, matrix(0, 20, n_mt_dummies)), addx=TRUE)) %>%
  rename(newmods = X.Duration)

eqn <- sprintf(
  "italic(y) == %.3g + %.3g * italic(x) * ',' ~~ italic(Qm) ~ '=' ~ %.2g * ',' ~~ italic(p) ~ '=' ~ %.1g * ',' ~~ italic(N) ~ '=' ~ %.0f",
  intercept, slope, Qm, p_value, N)

# pdf("1b_Fig_Across_Exp_NoAgeClass_Machine_Type.pdf", width=10, height=10)
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data=df, aes(x=Duration, y=Hedges_SMD), size=1/sqrt(df$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE), shape=21, fill="#D3D3D3") +
  geom_line(data=pred_df, aes(x=newmods, y=pred), color=cbPalette[6], linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data=pred_df, aes(x=newmods, ymin=ci.lb, ymax=ci.ub), linetype=2, alpha=0.1, color=cbPalette[6]) +
  ylab("Hedges SMD") + xlab("Duration") +
  smd_hlines + smd_theme +
  annotate("text", x=Durationmin, y=-1, label=eqn, parse=TRUE, hjust=0, size=5, color=cbPalette[6])
# dev.off()
```


### 2) Age classes

#### model output
```{r single models age classes}
#within each age class: test effect of duration (to account for 'nonlinearity')
df_Age_Class_1<-df %>% filter(Dur_Age_Class==1)
df_Age_Class_2<-df %>% filter(Dur_Age_Class==2)
df_Age_Class_3<-df %>% filter(Dur_Age_Class==3)
df_Age_Class_4<-df %>% filter(Dur_Age_Class==4)

RMADur_Age_Class_1<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df_Age_Class_1, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Duration)
RMADur_Age_Class_2<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df_Age_Class_2, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Duration)
RMADur_Age_Class_3<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df_Age_Class_3, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Duration)
RMADur_Age_Class_4<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df_Age_Class_4, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Duration)

RMADur_Age_Class_1
RMADur_Age_Class_2
RMADur_Age_Class_3
RMADur_Age_Class_4
```

#### pseudoR² 
```{r Pseudo R2 age classes}
age_dfs <- list(df_Age_Class_1, df_Age_Class_2, df_Age_Class_3, df_Age_Class_4)

r2_age_classes <- lapply(age_dfs, function(d) {
  ctrl <- list(iter.max=500, rel.tol=1e-8)  # needed for age class 3 null model
  null <- rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=d, random=list(~ 1 | Exp_ID / Observation_ID, ~ Year | Exp_ID), struct="CAR", mods=~ 1, method="ML", control=ctrl)
  full <- rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=d, random=list(~ 1 | Exp_ID / Observation_ID, ~ Year | Exp_ID), struct="CAR", mods=~ Duration, method="ML")
  r2_rma.mv(full, null)
})
names(r2_age_classes) <- paste0("Age_Class_", 1:4)
r2_age_classes #r2.loglik = used in manuscript
```

#### model validation
```{r model validation age classes}
age_models <- list(RMADur_Age_Class_1, RMADur_Age_Class_2, RMADur_Age_Class_3, RMADur_Age_Class_4)

for (i in 1:4) {
  Err <- resid(age_models[[i]])
  Fit <- fitted(age_models[[i]])
  plot(x=Fit, y=Err, xlab="fitted values", ylab="residuals", main=paste0("RMADur_Age_Class_", i, " - Residuals vs fitted SMD"))
  hist(Fit, main="Histogram fitted values SMD")
  qqnorm(Err, ylab="residuals", xlab="scores")
  plot(x=age_dfs[[i]]$Duration, y=Err, xlab="Duration", ylab="Residuals")
}
```

#### effect plot
```{r effect plot age classes}
# quick version separate
for (m in age_models) regplot(m, mod="Duration", xlab="Duration", ylab="Hedges SMD ER")

# long version combined
x_ranges <- list(c(0,4), c(5,9), c(10,14), c(15,25))
preds <- lapply(1:4, function(i)
  as.data.frame(predict(age_models[[i]], newmods=seq(x_ranges[[i]][1], x_ranges[[i]][2], length.out=20), addx=TRUE)))

make_eqn <- function(m) sprintf(
  "italic(y) == %.1g + %.1g * italic(x) * ',' ~~ italic(Qm) ~ '=' ~ %.1g * ',' ~~ italic(p) ~ '=' ~ %.1g * ',' ~~ italic(N) ~ '=' ~ %.0f",
  coef(m)[[1]], coef(m)[[2]], m$QM, m$pval[[2]], m$k)
eqns <- lapply(age_models, make_eqn)   # (old script used class 1 coefficients for class 4's label — fixed here)

pdf("Fig_3_b_raw.pdf", width=14, height=10)
p <- ggplot()
for (i in 1:4) {
  d <- age_dfs[[i]]
  p <- p +
    geom_point(data=d, aes(x=Duration, y=Hedges_SMD), size=1/sqrt(d$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE), shape=21, fill="#D3D3D3") +
    geom_line(data=preds[[i]], aes(x=X.Duration, y=pred), color=cbPalette[6], linewidth=1.2) +
    geom_ribbon(data=preds[[i]], aes(x=X.Duration, ymin=ci.lb, ymax=ci.ub), linetype=2, alpha=0.1, color=cbPalette[6])
}
p <- p +
  ylab("ER Hedges SMD") + xlab("Age Class") +
  smd_hlines + smd_theme +
  annotate("text", x=0,  y=2.2, label=eqns[[1]], parse=TRUE, hjust=0, size=5, color=cbPalette[6]) +
  annotate("text", x=4,  y=2.1, label=eqns[[2]], parse=TRUE, hjust=0, size=5, color=cbPalette[6]) +
  annotate("text", x=8,  y=2.0, label=eqns[[3]], parse=TRUE, hjust=0, size=5, color=cbPalette[6]) +
  annotate("text", x=15, y=1.9, label=eqns[[4]], parse=TRUE, hjust=0, size=5, color=cbPalette[6])
print(p)
dev.off()
```


### 3) Age classes, ~Duration
<!-- (originally in manuscript, shows persistency) -->
#### model output
```{r single models age class factor}
#1) Significant effect of the mean effect size per age class?
RMADur_Age_Class<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Dur_Age_Class)
summary(RMADur_Age_Class)

#2) Effect sizes per age class significantly different from zero?
RMADur_Age_Class_sign_zero<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~ -1+ Dur_Age_Class ) 
summary(RMADur_Age_Class_sign_zero)

#3) Effect over time differs between age classes? 
RMADur_Age_Class_Duration<-rma.mv(Hedges_SMD, Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE, data=df, random=list(~ 1 |  Exp_ID / Observation_ID , ~ Year |  Exp_ID ), struct="CAR", mods=~Dur_Age_Class:Duration)
```

#### posthoc: differences between age classes?
<!-- Even though the model is not significant, this is interesting to show that the difference lies between age class 1 and the others. -->
```{r posthoc}
summary(glht(RMADur_Age_Class,
             linfct=cbind(contrMat(c("Dur_Age_Class1"=1,"Dur_Age_Class2"=1,"Dur_Age_Class3"=1,"Dur_Age_Class4"=1), type="Tukey")),
             df=df.residual(RMADur_Age_Class)),
        test=adjusted("none"))
```

#### effect plot
```{r effect plot age class factor}
age_labels <- c("[0-5) yrs","[5-10) yrs","[10-15) yrs", ">=15 yrs")

d <- tibble(
  Dur_Age_Class = factor(age_labels, levels = age_labels),
  mean  = as.vector(RMADur_Age_Class_sign_zero$beta),
  lower = RMADur_Age_Class_sign_zero$ci.lb,
  upper = RMADur_Age_Class_sign_zero$ci.ub
)

Qm<-RMADur_Age_Class$QM
p<-RMADur_Age_Class$QMp
N<-RMADur_Age_Class$k

eqn <- sprintf("italic(Qm) ~ '=' ~ %.2g * ',' ~~ italic(p) ~ '=' ~ %.1g * ',' ~~ italic(N) == %.0f", Qm, p, N)

# full names for plotting (on a copy, so df keeps its original levels)
df_plot <- df %>% mutate(Dur_Age_Class = factor(Dur_Age_Class, labels = age_labels))

pdf("Fig_3_a_raw.pdf", width=14, height=10)
p_fig <- ggplot() +
  geom_violin(data=df_plot, aes(Dur_Age_Class, Hedges_SMD), alpha=0.5) +
  geom_jitter(data=df_plot, aes(Dur_Age_Class, Hedges_SMD), size=1/sqrt(df_plot$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE), shape=21, fill=cbPalette[1]) +
  geom_point(data=d, aes(x=Dur_Age_Class, y=mean), size=5, shape=21, fill=cbPalette[6], colour=cbPalette[6]) +
  geom_errorbar(data=d, aes(x=Dur_Age_Class, ymin=lower, ymax=upper), width=0.3, linewidth=1.2, color=cbPalette[6]) +
  ylab("ER Hedges SMD") + xlab("Duration") +
  smd_hlines +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(1.5, 2.5, 3.5), linetype="dashed", color=cbPalette[1], linewidth=0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.4,2.25), breaks=c(-2,-1,0,1,2,3)) +
  smd_theme +
  annotate("text", x=0.6, y=-1.2, label=eqn, parse=TRUE, hjust=0, size=5, color=cbPalette[6])
print(p_fig)
dev.off()
```
